name: Joinly

sources.title: Homepage — active startup launch board with Featured/Trending entries dated daily through Sep 26, 2026
Submit your startup or product — free public form with field specs (headline ≤80 chars, thumbnail 256×256 ≤200KB, up to 3 gallery images)

requirements: Startup or product name and main website URL — 'only the main domain or subdomain without any additional parameters, paths, or directories'
Headline: one line, up to 80 characters; optional long description
Thumbnail image 256×256px (1:1), max 200KB — required; up to 3 gallery images 1024×768 (4:3), max 400KB each
Must agree to T&C/privacy — data processed by Thomas Kraits United Kingdom Limited including marketing emails
preparation: Product name and root domain URL
256×256 square thumbnail ≤200KB and up to 3 screenshots 1024×768 ≤400KB
workflow: Fill name, URL, email, headline, description, country; upload thumbnail and gallery images
Accept the terms checkbox and submit
Approved entries appear in the Trending feed with a /startups/<domain-slug> detail page and a Visit website link
watchFor: No price is mentioned anywhere — appears genuinely free; no premium upsell visible on the form
The T&C consent includes marketing emails from Thomas Kraits UK Ltd
Listing quality is mixed — the feed includes adult-adjacent entries (Spicy Ranks AI, LiveJasmin stats), so the neighborhood is unfiltered
Review/approval criteria and turnaround are not stated
countsAsLive: A detail page at joinly.xyz/startups/<domain-slug> exists and the product appears in the homepage Trending/Startups feed with its Visit link
unknowns: Editorial review time and acceptance criteria
